instant.$description: No animation. Keyboard-initiated actions and anything seen 100+ times a day (emil-design-eng: never animate keyboard-initiated actions)

fast.$description: Micro-interactions: hover, colour and border changes (guidance: micro-interactions 100-150ms)

press.$description: Press feedback: the scale on :active (STANDARDS: transform scale(0.97) with ease-out; guidance: micro-interactions 100-150ms)

base.$description: Entrances of tooltips, popovers, dropdowns and selects (STANDARDS: 125-250ms; guidance: standard UI 150-250ms)

exit.$description: Exits of base-duration elements (popovers, dropdowns, bars): about 20% faster than the 200ms entrance, not more. Sheets and modals exit at calc(var(--sc-duration-slow) * 0.8) (emil-design-eng: exit faster than enter; guidance: about 20%)

slow.$description: Modals, drawers and bottom sheets only; larger elements move further, so slower (guidance: 200-300ms, UI stays under 300ms)

spin.$description: One rotation of the loading spinner, linear; stops under reduced motion (emil-design-eng: a faster spinner makes loading feel faster)

pulse.$description: One half-cycle of the loading skeleton's opacity pulse (alternate, linear); stops under reduced motion (emil-design-eng: constant motion is linear; MOT-12 keeps keyframes for the skeleton pulse)

enter.$description: Strong ease-out for anything entering, and the default (emil-design-eng: entering or exiting uses ease-out; built-in curves are too weak)

exit.$description: Strong ease-out for anything leaving, paired with duration.exit (emil-design-eng: never ease-in on UI; it delays the moment the user is watching)

standard.$description: Strong ease-in-out for elements already on screen that move or morph (emil-design-eng: moving or morphing on screen uses ease-in-out)

hover.$description: CSS ease, for hover and colour changes (emil-design-eng: hover or colour change uses ease)

drawer.$description: Bottom sheets and drawers: a fast start that settles softly (STANDARDS: iOS-like drawer curve)

press.$description: transform: scale() on :active for buttons, cards, chips and day cells; resolves to 1 under reduced motion (STANDARDS: subtle, 0.95-0.98)

enter.$description: Starting scale, with opacity 0, for popovers and dropdowns growing from their trigger; resolves to 1 under reduced motion (STANDARDS: never scale(0), start from 0.9-0.97)

$description: Distilled from github.com/emilkowalski/skills. Under prefers-reduced-motion, movement stops (spin and scale tokens resolve to their reducedMotion value) but opacity and colour transitions keep their durations: fewer and gentler animations, not zero.
